custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the scale texture. Real green mambas have very distinct, keeled or smooth scales depending on the exact species/subspecies, but they should look like individual overlapping plates. Check the eye: it must be round (diurnal) not vertical slit (nocturnal).
